title: Fix CI test failures: ObjectCalendar double-fetch, stale mock dates, live preview assertion
body:
Three test failures on `main` caused by a redundant data fetch, hardcoded dates rolling past the calendar viewport, and a test assertion contradicting the feature it validates.

### ObjectCalendar double-fetch (`ObjectCalendar.tsx`)

`objectSchema` in the data-fetch `useEffect` dep array caused `find()` to fire twice on mount — once with null schema, again when the schema-fetch effect resolved. Switched to `useRef` so the data-fetch reads the latest schema without re-triggering:

```tsx
const objectSchemaRef = useRef<any>(null);
objectSchemaRef.current = objectSchema;

// In data-fetch effect:
const expand = buildExpandFields(objectSchemaRef.current?.fields);
// deps no longer include objectSchema
```

### Date-sensitive mock data (`PluginsIntegration.test.tsx`)

Mock events used hardcoded Feb 2026 dates — invisible once the calendar's default month view advanced to March. Replaced with relative dates:

```ts
const ONE_DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
{ due_date: new Date(Date.now() + ONE_DAY_MS).toISOString() }
```

### Live preview assertion (`ReportViewConfigPanel.test.tsx`)

Test named "should update preview live" asserted the *old* title persisted after editing. Updated to assert the live-previewed value, matching the component's actual (correct) behavior.
